reviewer_statement: Developer six-domain review of existing complete native R full-refit bootstrap identity audit frames against frozen Python 1.2, including typed source dataclass/pandas cellwise evidence and native source id/draw ordering. Source dataclass/exception class identity cannot be native in R. Independent audit and full exact-head CI are not yet complete.
native_language_semantic_policy: The frozen Python FunctionalMixedEffectsFullRefitBootstrapResult typed record is represented by an explicitly checked R list or native S3 record. The pandas audit frame is represented by a native R data.frame preserving five source-named columns, zero-based draw indices and original scientific identity mapping. No statistical re-estimation is implied.

case_evidence.description: Python FunctionalMixedEffectsFullRefitBootstrapResult source-typed bootstrap record to native checked S3/list representation
One or many bootstrap samples, repeated source participants, repeated or empty nested trial audit sets, Unicode IDs
Zero-based bootstrap and draw indices, exact sampled source participant index, no aggregation and no random refit
Reject malformed bootstrap participant shape, negative source indices, inconsistent sampled identifiers or invalid nested trial records
Exact ordered five-column participant draw frame and five-column nested trial provenance frame including zero-row audit
Descriptive bootstrap-resampled source-to-target identity provenance; not inference, no fitted-model mutation

independent_review_status: developer-reviewed only; full exact-head CI and independent certification pending
language_specific_limits: Python frozen dataclass is not an R list/S3 object
Python pandas DataFrame is not R data.frame
TypeError and ValueError correspond to native semantic errors, not identical exception classes
